name: 炎黄武魂public-final-2016-12-08
english_name: Tales of Wulin Heroes: Soul of Yan-Huang (Public Final, 2016-12-08 Build)
english_description: Another branch of the "Doing" engine lineage — the master.lpc file header traces its history explicitly: "for ES II mudlib... updated by Doing Lu for hell (2K), modified by Linux@lxtx for yh 2003.3." In-game the title reads "Tales of Wulin Heroes: Soul of Yan-Huang." Registration splits surname and given name into separate prompts and requires both an admin password and a login password; character creation replaces the usual random-stat menu with a five-way archetype choice (Warrior/Sage/Endurance/Agility/Balanced) and skips the email step entirely.
